```http
GET /v1/view/{token}
```

Opened by the recipient from the link at the top of a message sent with `web_view: true`. The page is the HTML as sent, under a sandboxing Content-Security-Policy (no scripts, forms or same-origin access), not indexed by search engines. Links expire after 30 days, or earlier when the message's metadata is deleted.

## Authentication

None. This endpoint is public: it is called by browsers or mail clients, never with your API key.

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | path | string | yes | &nbsp; |
